summary: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit ab66c0d7. The release adds the KPG-23D TK-350 session and KPG-32D TK-359 session with OEM DTR/RTS behavior; reads UV-5R settings before channels for radios that reject the jump back; reports the real UV-3R handshake error; accepts a 32-byte MD-UV380 DFU identity while keeping memory reads strict; retries the TK-863G 0x7C memory session like KPG-76D and reports received bytes; and explains the safe CSV route when a full image belongs to a different UV-5R radio. Verification: flutter analyze passed; all 254 Flutter tests passed with the bundled Python 3.13 runtime; 672 bundled Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; DEB, RPM, and Pacman metadata and embedded version 1.0.76 were verified; DEB and AppImage Xvfb smoke tests passed; the AppImage launched under host Wayland and X11; package payloads include the new KPG, UV-5R, UV-3R, DFU, bridge, and TK-863G changes and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; all public downloads returned HTTP 200; and the Linux platform manifest reports 1.0.76. Package SHA-256 values: 3170f5a782647293747f5a93a64b2a297deb5b03a8d17be0b1edd2ca73cf6f49, 1aca797940d07b5949a188fde408b89fc22791f888c91cc2314c55230b83f73c, 467a9aa3a7032934dbcf982269fc73733e39088abe136a8bde5e13afa5a6a059, and 275d66593a360bc2702856a17e4a7f4ddf3744c1182b89a2241e418f7369f957.
title: Linux 1.0.76 published
